title: A file indexer
description:
Count words across text files in a folder, reading them in parallel.

```
3 files, 18 words, 12 different
most common: the (4), a (2), cat (2)
largest file: c.txt (9 words)
```
hints: `var texts = await Task.WhenAll(files.Select(f => File.ReadAllTextAsync(f)));` keeps the order of `files` (lesson 5.03).

Walk the characters of `text.ToLowerInvariant()`, collecting letters `a` to `z` into a `StringBuilder` and ending a word at any other character (as in practice 2.03); `counts[w] = counts.GetValueOrDefault(w) + 1` counts each one.
requirements: Create a folder with three small text files at the start (`Directory.CreateDirectory`, `File.WriteAllText`).
Count words (lower case, letters only) in a `Dictionary<string, int>`.
stretch: Watch the folder with `FileSystemWatcher` and update the counts when a file changes.
